text: Why is installing the best cable you can properly terminate usually the correct default?
choices: Installation labour dominates material cost, and the one thing you will not want to do in six years is pull it again
Higher categories are more resistant to theft
explanation: The labour to pull cable through a building is identical whether it is Cat5e or Cat6a; the material difference is pence per metre. This is one of the few places where 'buy the better one' is genuinely the right engineering answer rather than laziness.
